vkTargets.title: VK targets
vkTargets.description: VK walls to scrape. Accepts a public handle (`durov`), a profile or community URL (`https://vk.com/kinopoisk`), a signed owner ID (`-40316705`), or a direct post link (`https://vk.com/wall1_45678`).

accessToken.title: VK access token
accessToken.description: VK API access token with the `wall` scope. Strongly recommended: with a token the Actor uses the official VK API and returns every field (attachment URLs, view counts, exact timestamps, repost chains, comments). Without one it falls back to limited public HTML scraping.

maxItems.title: Maximum posts (total)
maxItems.description: Hard cap on the number of posts stored across all targets.

postsPerTarget.title: Maximum posts per target
postsPerTarget.description: Optional per-target cap. Leave empty to let each target use the shared budget.

publishedAfter.title: Published after
publishedAfter.description: Only keep posts published at or after this date. `YYYY-MM-DD` or a full ISO-8601 timestamp. Pagination stops once older posts are reached.

publishedBefore.title: Published before
publishedBefore.description: Only keep posts published at or before this date. A bare `YYYY-MM-DD` includes the whole day.

postFilter.title: Post filter
postFilter.description: Which posts to read from the wall. API mode only.
enumTitles: Only posts by the wall owner

includeComments.title: Include comments
includeComments.description: Fetch comment threads (including replies) for every post. Requires an access token and makes the run noticeably slower.

maxComments.title: Maximum comments per post
maxComments.description: Upper bound on comments fetched per post when "Include comments" is on.

includeRawPost.title: Include raw VK payload
includeRawPost.description: Attach the unmodified VK API object as `rawPost` on every item. Useful for fields this Actor does not map yet.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: VK blocks most datacenter IP ranges. Residential proxies are used by default.
